Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, machine learning, or a related technical field
Three or more years of relevant engineering or complex-product experience
Experience with requirements, interfaces, architecture, configuration, verification or multidisciplinary product integration
Ability to structure and maintain traceable technical information and drive cross-functional actions to closure
